findings.evidence: ParityOdd.lean:361-368: `conserved_left v := AlternatingMap.bilinMap_apply_left_eq_zero _ ![K.p, K.q] 1 v` and `isAlt := AlternatingMap.isAlt_bilinMap _ _` — both general in the form (Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/Alternating/BilinMap.lean:64, :70). Roadmap convention 6 supplies the parity-odd structure as data, and 0.3 bullet 1 requires building `A` from `Relativity.Tensors.RealTensor.Metrics.LeviCivita`'s volume form, which is an alternating form and not `b.det` of any basis in the library, so `aOfBasis` as stated is not reusable for that target.
findings.fix: Define `aOfAlt (ε : V [⋀^Fin 4]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (K : DisKinematics V) : Bilin V := ε.bilinMap ![K.p, K.q]`, mirroring `lMuNuOdd`; state `isAlt`/`conserved_left` for it with no basis at all, and state proper covariance as `parityOddAssumptions_aOfAlt (g) (ε) (b : Module.Basis (Fin 4) ℝ V) (K)`, proved by `ε = ε b • b.det` (`AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det`, upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Determinant.lean:650) followed by the present `Basis.det_comp` argument. Keep `aOfBasis b K := aOfAlt b.det K` as the derived special case if it is still wanted.
findings.issue: `aOfBasis (b : Module.Basis (Fin 4) ℝ V)` takes a basis where the natural datum is the alternating four-form itself. Two of the three `ParityOddAssumptions` fields (`isAlt`, `conserved_left`) are proved from the generic `AlternatingMap.bilinMap` API and use nothing about `b`; only `proper_covariant` touches `Basis.det_comp`. The basis is therefore a hypothesis stronger than the construction needs, and it is inconsistent with the leptonic side of the same development, `Leptonic.lMuNuOdd (ε : V [⋀^Fin 4]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) K := ε.bilinMap ![K.k, K.kPrime]` (Tensors/Basic.lean:275).

findings.evidence: ParityOdd.lean:180-186 and 217-221 are the two copies; `exists_half_turn` (Tensors/Basic.lean:1063) already returns `f u = -u ∧ f u' = -u'`, and `f` is linear, so on a `SpectatorPlane` it reverses the whole span of `e₁`, `e₂` — the fact the `_of_spectatorPlane` copy re-derives through `apply_eq_mul_apply_e₁_e₂`.
findings.fix: Prove one lemma `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero` from `SpectatorSplitting g K` plus `hrev : ∀ u, g K.q u = 0 → g (pTransverse g K) u = 0 → ∃ f, IsKinematicStabilizer g K f ∧ LinearMap.det f = 1 ∧ f u = -u`, with its three corollaries; then supply `hrev` from `SpectatorPartners` (via `exists_half_turn`) and from `SpectatorPlane` (via the single `e₁`,`e₂` half-turn, which negates `c₁ • e₁ + c₂ • e₂`) as two short lemmas. That removes four duplicated proofs and leaves `SpectatorPartners` justified by its own instance lemma rather than by a second copy of the argument.
findings.issue: The same four conclusions (`W p_T v = 0`, `W p v = 0`, and the two right-slot flips) are proved twice: once under `SpectatorPartners` (lines 175-213) and once under `SpectatorPlane` (lines 217-240). Both proofs run through the identical core — a determinant-one stabilizer that fixes `p_T` and reverses the spectator, fed to `Bilin.apply_eq_zero_of_apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_neg`. Under a `SpectatorPlane` the single half-turn built from `e₁`, `e₂` already reverses *every* vector of the plane, so both bundles are instances of one hypothesis. `SpectatorPartners` and its `partner` field (Tensors/Basic.lean:1150-1156) exist only to support the first copy: grep shows `partner` is used nowhere but `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero`, and `spectatorPartners_kFour` is consumed only through `toSpectatorSplitting` and `self_ne_zero_of_spectator` (ParityOdd.lean:517-518).

summary: Two generality defects: the canonical parity-odd structure is tied to a basis where the repo's own idiom (and the Layer 0.3 target) wants an arbitrary alternating four-form, and the `p_T`/`p` annihilation results are proved twice over two incomparable hypothesis bundles, one of which (`SpectatorPartners`) exists only to carry that duplicate proof.
